The first-generation Automate VX systems the API reference names, on the same API. Firmware before 6.4.2, on any Automate VX, serves the API over HTTP: turn Use HTTPS off and enter the port its web page opens on (3579 in the product manual). Not yet tested on this hardware.

Shares the same OSC address grammar as QLab 5; video-specific addresses differ. Not tested against real QLab 4.

Validated against QLab 5.6.1 over both UDP and TCP: login with a passcode, a wrong or missing passcode, a workspace that is not open, QLab quitting and restarting, GO/STOP/PANIC, cue start by number, and live feedback (version, current cue id/number/name, running state). OSC remote control is a free feature in QLab 5 across all license tiers (Free, Audio, Video, Lighting).

OBS Studio 28 or later on Windows, macOS or Linux (obs-websocket 5 is built in). OBS 27 and earlier need the obs-websocket 5 plugin installed separately; the 4.x plugin speaks a different protocol and is not supported.

Version 1.0 and later. LAN only (TCP 8023, eight-character network password). ROI windows; no AUX buses, freeze or macros.

Version 3.5 and later (the Basic Control Commands' own floor). LAN (TCP 8023, four-character network password) or RS-232. 20 input channels, AUX 1-3, four PinP & KEY, two DSK, 30 scene memories, 16 cameras.
Version 1.3 and later. LAN (TCP 8023, eight-character network password) or RS-232. Video and audio players, SRT, streaming and recording.
Version 2.2 and later. LAN (TCP 8023, four-character network password) or RS-232. Streaming and recording.
Version 2.2 and later. LAN (TCP 8023, four-character network password) or RS-232. Streaming and recording.

Built from Sennheiser's SSCv2 specification and the TC Bar OpenAPI 1.16 schema, which covers both bars. Not yet run against a bar. The camera's zoom position goes to 500 on the Bar M (150 in the Microsoft Teams profile) and to 300 on the Bar S (400 in the Zoom profile, 200 in Microsoft Teams). The Split network mode exists only on the Bar M.

All frames speak the same CORIOmax command-line API (CORIOmaster document v411.0.1, CORIOmaster2 document v503.0.1). Live event updates need firmware with the AddEvents mechanism (M411 / G503 documents); older firmware falls back to polling automatically. The unit accepts ONE controlling connection at a time — close CORIOgrapher before connecting OpenAVC. Standby mode is supported on the CORIOmaster micro only. Factory login is admin / adminpw.
